title: GTA 6 Made $3.79 Billion on Day One

segments.text: GTA Six made three point seven nine billion dollars. On day one.
After thirteen years, two delays, and a massive leak.
Rockstar never revealed the budget. Estimates range from one to two billion dollars.
But before launch, it had already sold thirty-two and a half million copies.
That's more than Avengers: Endgame made in its entire run in theaters.
And nearly five times what GTA Five made on its first day.
Rockstar bet that people would wait. They were right.
Worth thirteen years? Tell me in the comments.
